text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races,
I went out for tea with Mejiro McQueen.
Then, as if making up their mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I've made up my mind.
I――have decided."
choice_data_list: The Mont Blanc set after all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am not talking about the menu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? That hot springs voucher
we won in the shopping district raffle back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How to use that, of course. Now that I have succeeded
this far as an Umamusume, the one who deserves to go to a hot spring is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I believe they are the two biggest contributors.
Would you disagree?
When I asked who that was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It was a close call across the board,
but the way I see it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Just you and me. That seems only fitting.
Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As my Trainer, I believe you have both
the right and the duty to accompany me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What... do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You want to go?!
Talk about a direct pitch...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that is fine. It is settled then, yes?
Well then, please prepare for it in the near future.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I said it... I was able to say it...!)
And at last—we arrived at the hot spring inn.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... the bath was lovely.
Did you enjoy it as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
L-Let us chat a little before eating...
Uhmm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I hear this hot spring is good for joint pain, bruises, and poor circulation. It also has beautifying effects for the skin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Long ago in the Edo period, it flourished as a post town
and was visited by many travelers, or so I hear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The local specialties are onsen manju and simmered whole sweetfish...
In other words, what I want to talk about is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's not what this is about at all~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I managed to come, but I have no idea
how I should spend my time here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What should I... do...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Relaxing!? In this situation!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I truly admire your composure...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I really am no good, am I? Even after taking that step
away from the Mejiro family and studying running so earnestly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If I stray even a single step outside of that,
I don't even know how to spend my time anymore."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I truly am just a child. But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I believe being able to tell you you're acting like a child
is proof that I have grown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is what you think as well, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa, it feels as though the blood has rushed to my head.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though coming here has allowed me
to face you properly and head-on for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With you, Trainer, when you're not acting as a trainer.
We don't need to do any training here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is a pleasure to meet you.

It seemed the tension had drained from her.
Her eyes regained their usual spark.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first let us dine. Let us take our time
and savor this wholesome, nourishing cuisine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have so many things I want to talk about after that!
You had better keep me company.

Goofing around, laughing our hearts out...
Our idle chatter blossomed on and on endlessly.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Mejiro McQueen...
